items.title: Sample headline: this feed updates automatically
items.snippet: This placeholder item ships with the repo so the News page isn't empty before the first run. Once the 'Update security news feed' GitHub Action runs (on push, on a schedule, or manually via workflow_dispatch), it will replace this file with live headlines pulled from Krebs on Security, The Hacker News, BleepingComputer, Dark Reading, SecurityWeek, and The Record. You can also run it locally with `npm run fetch-news`.
